facts.fact: The DHIS2 country profile says Ethiopia's Ministry of Health began working toward full national implementation of DHIS2 as its HMIS in 2017, with HISP Ethiopia as technical partner.
The profile says that at many facilities and health posts data is collected on paper forms and then recorded in DHIS2 at the district level.
The DHIS2 profile says that as of 2024 DHIS2 data collection covered all of Ethiopia's 30,000+ public health facilities, giving routine data on health services and outcomes.
The profile says weekly notifiable disease surveillance data has been integrated into the DHIS2-based Public Health Emergency Management (PHEM) system.
